title: jab se ho tum hijaab me dil beqaraar hai
body:
jab se ho tum hijaab me dil beqaraar hai
har mazare hayaath nigaaho pa baar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar fizaae sub'ha tabassum kab aaoge
roothi hui chaman se, chaman ki bahaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jeene pa ahle dil ko na majboor ab karo
tum aao ya na aao , tumhe iqtiyaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
le jaayegi kahan mujhe diwaangie shouq
parde me tum ho daamane dil, taar taar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aakar ali ki tegh ke jouhar dikhaao ab
maidaane karbala ko bada intezaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar jab chalegi to aawaz aaegi
daste quda hai aur wahi zulfeqaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quraa'n zabaane haal se kehde ajab nahi
ye aaqri saheefaye parwardigaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jeete hai aetebaare mohabbat pa ham sayeed
apni to zindagi kai yahi shaahkaar hai
